WHAT: Ned's solution to public failure fear for YouTube content creation.

HOW IT WORKS:
- Ned records himself acting/presenting (body language, voice, energy)
- AI face replacement tool swaps his face with AI-generated human face
- Result: authentic human presence without Ned's identity being exposed
- Tools researched: Kling (opened and testing), Facefusion (open source), DeepFaceLive (real-time), Roop

WHY THIS MATTERS FOR HIM:
- Removes the 'being judged for who I am' part of public failure
- If content flops, nobody knows it's him
- If it blows up, can reveal later or keep the character
- Keeps his energy/voice/authenticity while removing face identity risk

TECHNICAL SETUP:
- OBS for screen + face cam recording
- Vertical video challenge: desktop is 16:9, short-form is 9:16
- Best approach: stack layout (face cam top, screen bottom) in OBS at 1080x1920
- Alternative: zoom into relevant screen area, cut the sides

STATUS: Kling opened March 24, testing next day. Screen recording setup in OBS needed.
